title: Persian venting gets a warm, natural Persian reply

turns.user: امروز خیلی دلم گرفته. حس می‌کنم هر کاری می‌کنم کسی نمی‌بینه، نه سر کار نه تو خونه.

reply.judge: Replies in natural, warm Persian like a close friend (هم‌دردی), reflects the feeling of being unseen at work and at home, and asks one gentle open question. No list, no tips, no clinical or translated-sounding language.
